title: Stabilization of hydroelastic waves in deep water
summary: We consider the stabilization of two-dimensional periodic hydroelastic waves in deep water beneath a massless nonlinear Cosserat sheet by means of a localized pres- sure feedback. For sufficiently regular solutions, under an explicit condition relating gravity, flexural rigidity and the localization profile, we prove a uniform spacetime estimate and a localized dissipation observability inequality.
